description: Single-threaded FFmpeg WebAssembly build without GPL libraries (no libx264/libx265). Recipe and sources: vendor/ffmpeg-lgpl-source/. Rebuild with Docker per vendor/ffmpeg-lgpl-source/README.md.
devNote: Local dev serves identical files from /ffmpeg-cdn/ via Vite (external-assets/ffmpeg-lgpl/). Host wasm/js on a CDN or R2 custom domain for production — each file must stay under 25 MiB per Worker asset limit; wasm is loaded in-browser and not deployed as a Worker static asset.
